title: AEGIS Umbilical Handshake Protocol — Vibe Architect
description: The step-by-step negotiation that occurs when a developer drags an Orb from the Library onto the Pod Crystal. The handshake is the Relation — the moment the Orb and Pod establish their contract. Each step will pass before the next begins; any shortfall rolls back to the library with a diagnostic.

handshake_id.description: Unique ID for this handshake attempt, generated at drag-release.

umbilical_port.description: The Pod port this Orb is attaching to (e.g. 'port-3'). Assigned by the Pod from its vacant set.

orb_detected.description: Pod reads the Orb package manifest and confirms it is a valid orb-package.schema.json document.

umbilical_connection_established.description: Pod selects a vacant umbilical port and opens the transport channel.

protocol_negotiated.description: Pod and Orb agree on wire format (json-ld, json, protobuf, msgpack).

direction_confirmed.description: Data flow direction (bidirectional, inbound_only, outbound_only) confirmed.

capabilities_exchanged.description: Orb transmits its capability list; Pod registers them in its capability manifest.

requirements_transmitted.description: Orb sends its full resource requirements (memory + processing + interfaces).

memory_requirements_validated.description: Pod confirms it can allocate the requested persistent and working memory.

processing_requirements_validated.description: Pod confirms CPU class, thread count, and latency budget fit its hardware profile.

negative_space_verified.description: Pod verifies the Orb's negative-space declarations are present and pass machine checks.

relation_contract.description: The generated Relation — the JSON-LD contract produced by the handshake, written to the Code/Relation View. Only present when status is 'relation_established'.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is 'rejected' (e.g. 'Insufficient GPU memory').

failed_step.description: Which handshake step fell short, when status is 'rejected' or 'rolled_back'.

pod_summary_after.description: Updated Pod state after successful handshake, populating the Pod Summary panel.
